I'm settling on "carcinoma in situ" as a Specific Disease, since it names one defined stage of cancer. For "invasive cancer" I'm checking whether it refers to a broader class of cancers rather than a single disease.

I'm leaning toward Specific Disease, though I'm noticing I've tagged similar "breast cancer" mentions in other ways, so I want to check that the choice stays consistent.
